quick_brief: API Week 1 Challenge: Test your basic programming skills in PHP grammar, defining variables, and examining interactive conditions!

questions.text: Which of the following tags is used to initialize writing code in PHP?
How do we declare and define a new variable and store values ​​in it in PHP?
What is the script command used to print and display text on the browser in PHP?
What code is used in PHP to connect two strings together?
Which logical statement is used to make a conditional decision and execute alternative code if the first condition is not met?
What is the correct result for printing the following code: $x = 10; $y = "10"; echo $x === $y;?
options: prints 0 or nothing (because they are different in type)
questions.correct: prints 0 or nothing (because they are different in type)

questions.text: When using condition code: if ($age >= 18) { echo 'Senior'; }, What is printed for age 18?
What is the main benefit of installing XAMPP server on desktop computer?
options: Providing local Apache server environment, MySQL database, and PHP interpreter to test the codes
Protecting the operating system from viruses
questions.correct: Providing local Apache server environment, MySQL database, and PHP interpreter to test the codes

questions.text: What tag do we use to end every line written in PHP to avoid errors of the Permian compiler?
How do we make a one-line comment in PHP to explain the code to other programmers?
Write code to define a variable named '$age' and store the value '15' in it, then write a condition to print the word 'Welcome, Senior' if the age is greater than or equal to 10 years.

Write code that links two strings together: a first variable named '$part1' with the value 'world' and a second variable named '$part2' with the value 'megaminds', and print the result of combining the two strings.
